mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CHDM001 (MSG_ID, CP_ID, CS_ID, PRIORITY, STAT, ST_DT, EN_DT, RC_ID, DISP_NM, DISP_INST, DISP_EVSE_ID, DISP_CONN_ID, CS_STATUS, REG_DT, REG_ID, UPD_DT, UPD_ID) VALUES (#{m.messageId}, #{m.cpId}, #{m.csId}, #{m.priority}, #{m.status}, #{m.startDate}, #{m.endDate}, #{m.rcId}, #{m.displayName}, #{m.displayInstance}, #{m.displayEvseId}, #{m.displayConnId}, #{m.csStatus}, NOW(), #{m.writer.regUserId}, NOW(), #{m.writer.updUserId})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CHDM001 SET PRIORITY = #{m.priority}, STAT = #{m.status}, ST_DT = #{m.startDate}, EN_DT = #{m.endDate}, RC_ID = #{m.rcId}, DISP_NM = #{m.displayName}, DISP_INST = #{m.displayInstance}, DISP_EVSE_ID = #{m.displayEvseId}, DISP_CONN_ID = #{m.displayConnId}, CS_STATUS = #{m.csStatus}, UPD_DT = NOW(), UPD_ID = #{m.writer.updUserId} WHERE MSG_ID = #{m.messageId} AND CP_ID = #{m.cpId} AND CS_ID = #{m.csId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.MSG_ID, m.CP_ID, m.CS_ID, m.PRIORITY, m.STAT, m.ST_DT, m.EN_DT, m.RC_ID, m.DISP_NM, m.DISP_INST, m.DISP_EVSE_ID, m.DISP_CONN_ID, m.CS_STATUS, m.REG_DT, m.REG_ID, m.UPD_DT, m.UPD_ID, c.MSG_LANG, c.MSG_FRMT, c.MSG_CONT FROM TB_CHDM001 m LEFT JOIN TB_CHDM002 c ON c.MSG_ID = m.MSG_ID WHERE m.CP_ID = #{cpId} AND m.CS_ID = #{csId} ORDER BY m.MSG_ID, c.MSG_LANG

SELECT MSG_ID, CP_ID, CS_ID, PRIORITY, STAT, ST_DT, EN_DT, RC_ID, DISP_NM, DISP_INST, DISP_EVSE_ID, DISP_CONN_ID, CS_STATUS, REG_DT, REG_ID, UPD_DT, UPD_ID FROM TB_CHDM001
ORDER BY MSG_ID DESC LIMIT #{cond.pageItemSize} OFFSET #{cond.start}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CHDM002 (MSG_ID, MSG_LANG, MSG_FRMT, MSG_CONT) VALUES (#{c.messageId}, #{c.msgLanguage}, #{c.msgFormat}, #{c.msgContent})

INSERT INTO TB_CHDM002 (MSG_ID, MSG_LANG, MSG_FRMT, MSG_CONT) VALUES (#{c.messageId}, #{c.msgLanguage}, #{c.msgFormat}, #{c.msgContent}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE MSG_FRMT = VALUES(MSG_FRMT), MSG_CONT = VALUES(MSG_CONT)
mapper.select: SELECT MSG_ID, MSG_LANG, MSG_FRMT, MSG_CONT FROM TB_CHDM002 WHERE MSG_ID = #{messageId} ORDER BY MSG_LANG
